title: Carry the exact 2026-09-06 Nous delivery as technical provenance

outcomes.statement: The exact 17-path operator delivery lands under technical ownership with tenant guidance re-homed and protected agent-document divergence recorded, without being attributed to US-058.
outcomes.demo: Compare the resulting commit with preserved commit 1d52117: exactly the 17 delivered paths retain their bytes, intended provenance-only agent-document deltas remain provenance-only, and WORK_READINESS.md records the IMP-393 protection boundary and tenant-owned guidance location.

uncertainties.statement: Whether the delivery bytes can be preserved after their local commit was initially attributed to US-058.
uncertainties.resolution: The unpushed commit 1d52117 preserves the exact delivery in Git. A controlled local history repair can reattribute that unchanged tree to CHG-050 without rerunning adopt/sync or modifying any delivered byte.

uncertainties.statement: Whether the required diverged-protection note is already present in the delivered WORK_READINESS.md bytes.
uncertainties.resolution: The carried file contains the re-homed tenant guidance, but the explicit IMP-393 diverged-protection statement must be verified and, if absent, added within this child while keeping the total at 17 paths because WORK_READINESS.md is already in scope.
